source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Press load default,save and reboot.
3. Boot in BIOS,compare setting should matches SPEC.
4. Change BIOS all/random setting in this function,to non-default  setting.
5. Save and reboot.
6. Boot in BIOS and check your setting still exist.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. The default setting should matches SPEC."
2. No error log happen.
3. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
4. Check your set still exist.

original_test_intent: Verify UEFI Network Stack defaults and persistence of approved non-default controls without selecting an unintended network boot service or image, exposing management traffic, losing local boot or changing required IPv4/IPv6 behavior.
original_method: Manually load BIOS defaults, compare named network-stack fields with SPEC, apply a bounded field/service matrix, save/reboot, verify persistence and observe UEFI NIC, boot-service, host and BMC behavior on an isolated test network.
manual_activity: An engineer must operate and visually accept the firmware Network Stack fields and observe the intended boot selection. Automated service, network and log collection is supporting evidence only.
required_inputs: Named Network Stack, IPv4/IPv6, PXE/HTTP and boot-order fields with SPEC defaults
Approved bounded values and expected UEFI NIC/boot behavior
Isolated VLAN/subnet, DHCP/PXE/HTTP endpoints and approved non-destructive boot image
Independent console/OOB and local recovery boot path
Approved final network and boot configuration
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or point firmware at production or unapproved DHCP, PXE, HTTP or image services.
Use an isolated test network and verify server identity, address scope and image provenance before enabling remote boot.
Do not alter BMC management networking as a substitute for UEFI Network Stack testing.
Protect local recovery boot and independent console/OOB access; avoid unattended installation images or writable deployment workflows.
Stop on unexpected image/service selection, network leakage, management loss, local-boot loss or security/certificate failure.
Restore the approved boot/network state; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only UEFI boot entries/NIC identity where exposed, link/address state, isolated service logs, boot evidence, BMC reachability and host logs around operator phases.
Correlate DHCP/PXE/HTTP transactions to the approved SUT and image without initiating deployment.
Do not drive BIOS, provision network services beyond an approved plan, alter boot order or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve firmware fields, isolated topology, service/image identities, boot expectations and recovery.
Perform and capture default-first and bounded non-default BIOS phases and intentionally select only approved boot paths.
Interpret boot/network/security evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; OS NIC configuration or BMC network changes would test different layers.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the firmware method and add read-only, version-recorded UEFI boot/NIC, service transaction, host and BMC evidence from an isolated environment.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The default-first lifecycle, null script and 5/20-minute fields are retained; all/random remains source text only.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each firmware field to UEFI NIC and boot behavior, execute only approved default/non-default scenarios on an isolated subnet, and correlate firmware captures with DHCP/PXE/HTTP transactions and exact image identity.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact UEFI Network Stack implementation, NIC firmware and project boot infrastructure.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC/NIC firmware, service versions/configuration and image digest.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform Network Stack documentation and approved DHCP/PXE/HTTP boot-service guidance.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces random changes with bounded field/service/image scenarios and explicit isolation/recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; preserves default/persistence and adds service selection, image provenance and local-recovery coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Fields, defaults, isolated services, image digest, boot expectations and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Host network state alone cannot prove firmware boot behavior; service logs must be time- and identity-correlated.

project_override_considerations: A project may test only approved PXE or HTTP, IPv4 or IPv6, and named NICs. Results must state protocol/NIC/image exclusions and cannot claim all Network Stack paths.
expected_evidence: Platform/NIC identity, field/default matrix, isolated topology, service/image approvals and recovery
Baseline firmware network/boot values, UEFI NIC/boot entries, host and BMC health
Load Default captures plus SPEC and local/remote boot comparison
Non-default captures, persistence and identity-correlated DHCP/PXE/HTTP evidence
Approved final boot/network state, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The default-first and persistence lifecycle agrees with the criteria. Protocol, service and image specifics are project readiness inputs, not contradictory source facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The firmware network-stack lifecycle is clear. Missing project services, values or recovery prevent a run but do not make the reusable master case permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees on manual firmware operation and adds remote-boot isolation, image provenance and recovery safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its isolated service and host/BMC evidence while correcting classification to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates visual firmware acceptance from automated service evidence and explicitly forbids unintended deployment or production-network contact.

review_improvement: Makes network-stack persistence traceable to the intended NIC, protocol, server and immutable image while preserving local boot and management recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: The core acceptance is interactive firmware configuration and boot observation. Network/service telemetry can corroborate it but cannot replace the human BIOS work, so MANUAL ONLY is required.
no_automatic_retry: Do not automatically repeat network-stack changes, remote-boot attempts or recovery after unexpected service/image selection, leakage, boot or management anomalies; preserve first evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
